Subject: Azure PC referral: Contoso account stitch request - routing proposal

Hi Sarah and PC intake team,

Attaching the Contoso account rollup we promised. The referral landed in Partner Center for a set of 12 Contoso-owned subscriptions that appear to map to three field sellers. Before we ask Microsoft to auto-assign, I want to align on a recommended stitch so the Contoso AE team gets routed consistently and we avoid churn in the referral flow.

High level ask:
- Can PC intake accept a proposed mapping (attached) and apply consent/owner tags to the Referral entries?
- If PC rules block that, what's the minimal evidence we should provide to speed owner assignment?

Key constraints:
- Contoso prefers a single AE per account family (see column A in attached CSV).
- Several subscriptions live under partner-managed billing; those need manual owner confirmation.

Attachments:
- contoso-account-list.csv (account + subscription mapping)
- proposed-routing-matrix.xlsx (my recommended owner assignments + rationale)

Next steps I propose: Jordan to own the intake with PC; Vanessa to validate seller assignments with field; Ben to confirm technical consent artifacts (PC snapshot). Timeline: aim to close mapping and push to PC by end of next week (2026-06-23).

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Sr. Partner GTM Manager | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Jordan — thanks for the packet and for pulling this together. Quick notes after a brief skim:

- Routing: I agree with the owner choices in the proposed-routing-matrix for 9/12 accounts. The three edge cases flagged in the matrix should be routed to the regional AE (West US) rather than EMEA. I'll confirm the exact AE names by EOD Wednesday.

- Orphan subscriptions: For the 2 subscriptions under partner-managed billing, we should treat them as manual claim (no auto-assign).

Following up with the consent artefacts. I pulled the current Partner Center referral snapshot and exported the consent logs for the 12 subscriptions. See attachment: pc-consent-snapshot.pdf. Notes:

- The snapshot shows timestamps and the originating seller email for 9/12 subscriptions. The remaining three have missing seller-email fields — these are the same three you flagged as edge cases.
- For the two regulated-subscriptions, we have a separate consent audit that includes IP/time stamps and the Contoso SO number. I can redact and push that as a separate doc for audit only if Contoso signs the NDA addendum.

Attaching: pc-consent-snapshot.pdf
